main_idea: GRPO training improved Qwen3.8-27B-Medium’s DeepSWE pass@1 by 11.3 points.
ideas: GRPO raised DeepSWE pass@1 from 27.8% to 39.1%.
Tasks came from enterprise codebases and covered five languages.
Training used eight attempts per task and 15 updates.
summary: The chart is clear, but the long headline, repeated training counts, method and provenance cards, and footer add clutter.
